---
title: "KaTeX set with the object form of html-math-method"
format:
  html:
    html-math-method:
      method: katex
      url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@latest/dist/"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['window\.backupDefine = window\.define', 'window\.define = window\.backupDefine']
        - ['<script defer="" src="[^"]*katex\.min\.js"']
---
